                The KIRC houses the university Library which is largely open-access with free shelf browsing and borrowing. Explore Our Services Visit Us Today About KIRC The Knowledge and Information Resource Center (KIRC) houses the university Library which is largely open-access. 
                    Readers have free access to the shelves and may browse and/or borrow books at will. Membership DarTU Members: Free access after registration Non-DarTU Users: Monthly membership available Monthly Fee: TZS 10,000 Special Collections Books and materials in special reserve or reference collections are not available for borrowing. 
                        These are highly valued, rare materials with wide use by both staff and students. Library Collections Our collection is divided into two main sections to serve different academic needs Open Access Collection Borrowing Limits: Students: Up to 3 books Academic Staff: Up to 5 books Loan Period: 2 weeks Special Reserve Collection High-Demand Materials: 3-hour loan period In-library use only Note: These materials are not available for home borrowing due to high demand and limited availability. Library Services Reader Services General circulation and user assistance for all library patrons Technical Services Cataloging and material processing for efficient resource management Reference Services Specialized research assistance and guidance for academic projects Electronic Resources & Periodicals Access our extensive collection of online journals and databases through our subscriptions with the Consortium of Tanzania Universities and Research Libraries (COTUL) EBSCO Host Comprehensive academic database with multidisciplinary research content Access Database Emerald Research articles and case studies in business, management, and social sciences Access Database Research4Life Scientific journals and resources for developing countries research Access Database Access Information Access is IP-based and available within DarTU network. Connect to the university network to access these premium research databases. Library Catalogue (OPAC) Access our library materials through our Online Public Access Catalogue (OPAC), powered by KOHA Integrated Library Software . Search for books, journals, and other resources in our collection. Access KOHA Library System Search our complete library collection through our professional KOHA Integrated Library Management System. 
                            Find books, journals, theses, and digital resources in real-time. Launch KOHA OPAC Advanced Search Multiple search criteria and filters Real-time Status Live availability and location info User Account Manage loans and reservations Digital Resources Access to electronic materials Access Requirements KOHA system access is available to all registered library members. 
                                Connect from within DarTU network for full functionality.
